payload.name: Upgrade 13 Developer Essentials
payload.description:
Create a new ferment that applies the Combined Lens pedagogy upgrade to the 13_Developer_Essentials/ folder, following the EXACT same methodology used for Ferment 019ec1fc (Upgrade 07 Modern Java) and Ferment 019ec421 (Upgrade 08 SQL).

User said: "create a ferment and upgrade the guides like you did".

## Background

The Combined Lens rubric lives in `00_CONTEXT/PEDAGOGY_STANDARDS.md` (5 dimensions: Conceptual Depth, Topical Breadth, Production Reality, Historical Evolution, Pedagogical Craft). The curriculum-wide audit at `00_CONTEXT/PEDAGOGY_AUDIT_2026.md` scored `13_Developer_Essentials` — need to re-check that file for the baseline score.

Prior ferments (019ec153 Algorithms, 019ec1c9 Patterns, 019ec1ee OOP, 019ec1ec Problem Solving, 019ec1fc Modern Java, 019ec421 SQL) established the workflow:
1. **Phase 1 — Audit**: Per-file Combined Lens scoring across all files; produce `<FOLDER>_AUDIT.md` with P2-UPGRADE-NN entries; produce `<FOLDER>_DIAGRAM_INVENTORY.md` (ASCII diagram quality assessment). Mirror to `.kimchi/ferments/<id>/docs/`.
2. **Phase 2 — Upgrade flagged files**: HE additions (canonical years for Git/Docker/CI-CD/Linux/K8s/Networking history), PR additions (named failure modes from verified library), Diagram enhancements (crystal clear labels + NEW sequence diagrams for concurrent/distributed topics), CD/TB depth-and-breadth (conceptual depth paragraphs + variant trade-off tables where applicable).
3. **Phase 3 — Finalize**: Update `00_CONTEXT/CHANGE_JOURNAL.md`, run `python3 tools/update_context.py update + check`, verify all success criteria.

## Target folder

`13_Developer_Essentials/` — covers Git, Docker, CI/CD, networking, concurrency, and other foundational dev topics. Need to confirm file count and chapter layout.

## Constraints (mirror prior ferments)

- Preserve all existing content per D003 (additions only, no removal)
- Preserve any existing 5W1H blocks per D014
- Skip meta files (00_INDEX.md, CONTEXT.md) for upgrade additions per precedent
- Use P2-UPGRADE-NN naming, AUDIT doc at folder root + ferment docs mirror
- Diagram improvements ASCII/Unicode-only (no images, no SVG)
- Mirror prior upgrade log naming: `<FOLDER>_HE_UPGRADE_LOG.md`, `<FOLDER>_PR_UPGRADE_LOG.md`, `<FOLDER>_DIAGRAM_UPGRADE_LOG.md`, `<FOLDER>_CD_TB_UPGRADE_LOG.md`

## Success criteria (auto-set, mirror prior ferments)

- All files audited against Combined Lens rubric (P2-UPGRADE entries in AUDIT doc)
- Flagged files upgraded with HE + PR + diagram enhancements + CD/TB additions
- Year-regex count, PR-phrase count, diagram-character count, invariant/trade-off/variant count all exceed baseline
- 5W1H preserved (D014), existing content preserved (D003)
- 4 upgrade logs + diagram inventory + preservation verification in `.kimchi/ferments/<id>/docs/`
- `00_CONTEXT/CHANGE_JOURNAL.md` updated
- `python3 tools/update_context.py update + check` passes exit 0

## User mode

User said "like you did" — interpret as: proceed with the established Combined Lens methodology, mirror prior ferments, use sensible defaults, do not pause for preference questions.

## Scope warning

Prior ferments audited 28 (Patterns), 43 (Algorithms), ~50-60 (OOP, Problem Solving), 74 (Modern Java), 51 (SQL) files. 13_Developer_Essentials likely sits in the 30-60 file range. Expect Phase 1 to need 2-3 parallel audit subagents and Phase 2 to need 2-3 parallel upgrade subagents, mirroring the prior batch approach.
